_doc: Run-root inputs of the offline evaluation (src/filament_seg/evaluation, scripts/eval_*.py), relative to FILAMENT_WORK. Staged by `tests/smoke/stage_work.py --eval`. Every one is a training-side out-of-fold artifact or competition data; no MAGFiLO release file and no test annotation. 'generate' is built by this repository's own code.

_roles.predictions/vessel_oof_full/by_image: the D007 >= 400 px reference arm (held-out-annotator and morphology evaluations): D007 OOF argmax binaries
_roles.extracted/training: OPTIONAL, only for --records png (historical replication): the per-annotator-record PNG tree, a PNG export of the competition COCO, not in the competition download. The default reference of the annotator-agreement and never-seen evaluations is the competition COCO (records_coco)
_roles.analysis/datastudy_diskfit.json: per-frame limb fit (disk centre and radius; image-derived, no annotation): only the r/R feature of the never-seen evaluation, which also fixes the RNG stream of the support interval
_roles.predictions/oof_d036/by_image: the selector's file member D036 (configs/FAST.json cpu_stage.members); the second member, P, is computed from the base map

_bundle: Without these maps: `python -m filament_seg.evaluation.bundle stage --work WORK` fills the same WORK paths from the tracked eval_bundle/ (selector OOF rows as analysis/oof_rows_FAST.npz, threshold-level base maps, D007 binaries, limb fit) and from YOUR competition download (training COCO; channel 0 of the 707 training JPEGs). The member dir is then not needed: the bundled rows replace the selector's feature build.
